query.title: Search
query.description: English sound, material or action, e.g. whoosh, glitch, metal hit, click. Leave empty to browse.

ids.title: Exact sound IDs
ids.description: Optional IDs returned by a previous search. Unknown IDs are rejected.

maxDuration.title: Maximum duration (seconds)
maxDuration.description: Only return effects no longer than this duration.

limit.title: Maximum sounds
limit.description: Maximum number of delivered sounds. Each delivered sound is a billable event when monetization is enabled. Zero results means zero sound events.

format.title: Audio format
format.description: 48 kHz mono WAV (16-bit PCM) or MP3 (192 kbps).
